answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because spiral only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, cipher is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any comet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
